_law: FROZEN BENCHMARK COMPARISON LAW. It describes which comparison operations exist, what each may prove, and what forces UNKNOWN. It contains NO card answer, NO pair verdict, NO member list and NO candidate data. Derived comparison results are external audit output and never become canonical projection facts.
_what: AQ4 shared candidate-neutral COMPARISON ALGEBRA. Packet 7, repaired. Benchmark evaluation law only: it creates no production law, ratifies no architecture, mints no production vocabulary, contracts no dimension and authorizes no candidate encoder. Production AQ4 architecture remains UNRATIFIED.

projection_dependency._law: The algebra consumes ONLY documents that validate under this exact schema at this exact version. THE PROJECTION VALIDATOR IS AUTHORITATIVE for payload shape; this file never re-implements it as a competing validator. Defensive handling may still fail closed, and a malformed payload NEVER becomes semantic evidence.

dependencies.hierarchy_source: foundry_object_lattice.SUBTYPE_TO_TYPE -- the ratified EXTRACT-3 primitive, consumed and never re-derived

result_domain._law: Exactly three. No fourth public comparison verdict. UNKNOWN is first-class and never means false, absent, incompatible, disjoint, or searched-and-not-found.

proof_kinds._law: Exactly two, both PROVENANCE on the derived relation. A proof kind is never a verdict and nothing branches on it except the audit trail. No third proof kind is created.
proof_kinds.CR_CONTRACT: Established from ratified contract law -- a dimension contract, the atom semantics, a CR-closed vocabulary, or the ratified subtype-to-type hierarchy. The record names the dimension and a REAL rule anchor.
proof_kinds.CORPUS_WITNESS: Established from one named printed card, in one of two ratified ROLES (below). Carries corpus_ref, witness identity, admissible evidence, the governing dimension contract, and any completeness declaration relied upon.

organizing_law._statement: A UNIVERSAL claim is contract-provable; an EXISTENTIAL claim needs a corpus witness.
organizing_law.universal: Every object satisfying X also satisfies Y -- provable from the dimension contracts, the atom semantics and the CR hierarchy.
organizing_law.existential: There is an object satisfying X (and violating Y) -- not provable from contracts, because non-contradiction is not nonempty intersection. Requires a positive witness.
organizing_law.consequence: Non-entailment and overlap are existential and need a witness; entailment and disjointness are universal. This is why an inability to prove something can never become PROVEN_NOT.

closure_declaration.statement: A PROVEN verdict is a claim about the PROJECTED fact sets under comparison. It is NOT a claim that either projection is semantically complete.
closure_declaration.missing_is_not_absent: A dimension carrying no fact contributes no atom. It is never read as ABSENT and never yields an absence claim; in the equality operation it is reported as MISSING_FACT and forces UNKNOWN.
closure_declaration.who_polices_completeness: The symmetric false-precision veto, not the algebra. Every PROVEN verdict enumerates the facts it consumed.
closure_declaration.vacuity_guard: Two units with no actionable facts do not compare equal. A vacuous proof is false precision and returns UNKNOWN.

operations.name: normalized eligibility/constraint equality -- mutual entailment
operations.contract_anchor: 17 equality (mutual entailment), named explicitly per register #32
operations.semantic_question: Are the two projected constraint sets mutually entailing?
operations._naming_law: THE ONLY RATIFIED POSITIVE EQUALITY OPERATION, and it is eligibility/constraint equality. There is deliberately NO bare operation named for whole-unit equality: a generic name invites exactly the whole-unit reading register #32 refused.
proven_obligations: OP_ENTAILS is PROVEN in both directions
every dimension actionable on one side is actionable on the other (coverage)
at least one actionable fact exists (non-vacuity)
proven_not_obligations: OP_ENTAILS is PROVEN_NOT in at least one direction
unknown_conditions: a dimension is actionable on one side and missing on the other -- missing is never absent
both sides are empty of actionable facts

operations.name: nonempty intersection of two projected constraint sets
operations.semantic_question: Is there an object satisfying both projected constraint sets?
proven_obligations: NONEMPTY_INTERSECTION_PROVEN: an admissible corpus witness whose declared assignments satisfy EVERY atom of BOTH sides
proven_not_obligations: EMPTY_INTERSECTION_PROVEN: a CR CONTRACT CONTRADICTION -- see contradiction_forms
unknown_conditions: no witness offered; a witness searched for and not found; an inadmissible or non-satisfying witness
mere compatibility -- compatibility is not overlap
no CR contract contradiction found -- non-contradiction is not disjointness
operations._one_proposition_two_poles: OVERLAP names the PROVEN pole and DISJOINT the PROVEN_NOT pole of this single proposition, exposed as two readers so they can never disagree.

contradiction_forms._law: The only admissible proofs of EMPTY_INTERSECTION_PROVEN. Corpus absence is inadmissible in every direction.
forms: a same-value REQUIRES against FORBIDS on one dimension (atom semantics)
incompatible REQUIRES values on a dimension that is closed AND single-valued AND must-have
disjoint cardinality ranges on one dimension
disjoint interval ranges on one dimension

DISJUNCTION_RULE._law: REPAIRED. A disjunctive required value set contradicts a forbidding constraint ONLY WHEN EVERY admissible required alternative is eliminated.
DISJUNCTION_RULE.not_a_contradiction: requiring [artifact, creature] against forbidding artifact -- creature remains satisfiable
DISJUNCTION_RULE.is_a_contradiction: requiring [artifact, creature] against forbidding artifact AND forbidding creature -- every alternative eliminated
DISJUNCTION_RULE._why_recorded: the quarantined implementation proved EMPTY_INTERSECTION on any overlap between the two value sets, which is a false disjointness proof and therefore a false PROVEN_NOT.

distinguishing_witness._law: An additional ROLE for the existing corpus-witness proof kind, ratified in register #33. NOT a third proof kind. One admissible printed-card witness satisfying antecedent A and DEMONSTRABLY violating consequent B proves that A does not entail B. Witness absence proves nothing and a failed search stays UNKNOWN.

decidability_restrictions.FORBIDS: a positively observed forbidden value MAY demonstrate violation, and needs no completeness declaration -- presence is an observation
decidability_restrictions.REQUIRES: non-satisfaction demonstrates violation ONLY where the witness carries an evidence-traced COMPLETE assignment for that dimension. Without completeness the result is UNKNOWN
decidability_restrictions.CARD: requires a complete assignment for the dimension; the cardinality is a property of the whole value set
decidability_restrictions.INTERVAL: requires a complete assignment for the dimension
decidability_restrictions.EQUALITY_ONLY_DIMENSIONS: a value or spelling mismatch is NOT violation. UNKNOWN unless independent accepted law proves contradiction
decidability_restrictions.MALFORMED_PAYLOAD: NEVER proves violation. Malformed input fails closed to UNKNOWN; the projection validator is what rejects it
decidability_restrictions.OPEN_VOCABULARY_OR_INCOMPLETE_ASSIGNMENT: no negative inference of any kind

record_must_carry: the completeness declaration where relied upon

participant_correspondence._status: NOT RATIFIED -- and the consequence is implemented conservatively rather than reasoned around.
participant_correspondence.law: Participant integers are LOCAL to one semantic occurrence. Participant 0 on one occurrence and participant 0 on another have no semantic correspondence, and no printed-order cross-card correspondence is ratified.
participant_correspondence.consequence: A comparison whose outcome would depend on a PARTICIPANT-scoped fact returns UNKNOWN with reason NO_PARTICIPANT_CORRESPONDENCE. Aligning such facts by ordinal would give the integers a cross-occurrence meaning the contract explicitly withholds.
participant_correspondence.never: participant-set integer identity is never positive evidence for any comparison
participant_correspondence.reversal: if correspondence is later contracted, this restriction lifts with it and nothing else changes.

unknown_propagation.rule: PROVEN_NOT if any component is PROVEN_NOT; otherwise PROVEN if every component is PROVEN; otherwise UNKNOWN.

proof_record._law: Derived audit material, never canonical semantic truth. A proof record may never be written back into a projection document.

components._law: ONLY genuine semantic proof components enter the three-valued composition. A component carries a result, and where the result is PROVEN or PROVEN_NOT it carries a proof kind and a REAL contract anchor.

preconditions._law: REPAIRED, register #37. A structural check that was evaluated and did NOT block is recorded HERE and nowhere else. It carries no comparison result, no proof kind and no anchor, and it never enters the composition. A non-blocking check is not a proof.
examples: cost regions observed on either side
relation edges observed on either side

proof_record.cr_anchor_law: A contract proof must cite a real applicable rule or contract anchor. EXPLANATORY PROSE IS NEVER AN ANCHOR.
proof_record.trace_obligation: A PROVEN or PROVEN_NOT record carries at least one evidence reference from a consuming component, and a corpus-witness record additionally pins its corpus_ref. An UNKNOWN record carries a registered reason class. Self-checked on every record.
proof_record.ordering: components and preconditions sorted canonically; symmetric operations canonically order their operands so the record is byte-identical under reversal.

derived_question_layer._law: Consumer answers are DERIVED OUTPUT. They are not canonical projection facts, not an answer key, and nothing here adjudicates any card.

B1.question: semantically equal under normalization despite different wording
B1.positive_arm: UNAVAILABLE IN v1 (register #32). There is no positive whole-unit semantic-equality proof and no generic whole-unit equality operator.
B1.negative_arm: PROVEN_NOT only where eligibility non-equivalence is independently proven under accepted law -- in v1, an admissible distinguishing corpus witness.
B1._why: the projection does not represent all uncontracted semantic residue, so equality of projected content is not equality of semantic content. No completeness attestation exists in v1.

B2.question: is A's eligibility broader / narrower / overlapping / disjoint / UNKNOWN vs B's

labels._law: Six derived ANSWER LABELS for one consumer question, not comparison verdicts. The verdicts stay three.
labels.EQUAL: OP_ELIGIBILITY_EQUALITY is PROVEN. Never mapped to OVERLAPPING; an overlap claim needs its own witness.
labels.BROADER: STRICT -- A's set contains B's: entailment from B to A is PROVEN and entailment from A to B is PROVEN_NOT
labels.UNKNOWN: everything else, including one direction PROVEN with the reverse UNKNOWN

B2.orientation: Audited against the consumer contract's own wording -- the question asks about A's eligibility RELATIVE TO B's, so BROADER means A admits at least everything B admits.
B2.directional: the label is stated for a named subject; the stored pair remains unordered

B3.question: actions equivalent while eligibility differs
B3.action_arm: UNKNOWN / NO_CONTRACTED_COMPARISON_LAW. No action-equivalence operator exists and none is added.
B3.structural_report: printed head sequences identical / different / unavailable -- NON-VERDICT audit metadata that never influences a semantic result

B4.question: eligibility equal while destination / timing / quantity differs

summary_grouping._status: PRESENTATION LABEL ONLY. It groups already-authorized per-dimension verdicts for display and changes no semantic truth; the verdict table does not depend on it.

C1.question: what exact fact prevents B from strictly replacing A
C1.output: an ordered BLOCKER LIST of independently authorized semantic differences, with the direction named explicitly
C1.direction_law: directional over the frozen UNORDERED pair; the direction is an argument at answer time and no directed pair is stored
C1.cost: reportable only as the authorized structural residue condition, never as a compared dimension
C1.explicit_non_claim: an EMPTY blocker list is NEVER a positive equality or replacement claim

C2.question: is A's exile linked to a return
C2.output: a within-card structural read of projected relation edges; no comparison operation is involved
C2.absence_law: absence of an edge is NOT proof of no linkage

C3.question: are two units alternatives, cumulative, or independent
C3.input: the Packet-4 generated structural choice-group record ONLY. The comparator parses no Oracle text.
C3.ALTERNATIVE: both units are members of one group, in DIFFERENT options, and the group's selection max is 1 -- at most one option is chosen
C3.CUMULATIVE: both units are members of one group AND either share one option, or the group's selection min equals its option count so every option is chosen
C3.INDEPENDENT: NOT DERIVABLE IN v1 -- audited and reported rather than minted. Nothing the projection carries positively establishes independent ownership/ability structure; absence of a group is NOT proof of independence.

DISCOVERY-1.question: which broad facts remain shared despite narrower predicates
DISCOVERY-1.output: atoms both constraint sets entail with result PROVEN, from the units' own atoms plus their ratified hierarchy ancestors

E1.output: a validated trace/provenance object, never prose
E1.domain: the 354 unique unordered pairs of the semantic tranches, ONE trace per pair

HONESTY-1.output: the non-actionable components blocking a strict claim

HONESTY-2.output: scoring-time claimant-side property; the algebra implements only the consequence that an unearned absence claim degrades to UNKNOWN

unit_binding_dependency._law: The comparator accepts EXPLICITLY SUPPLIED unit inputs and selects nothing itself. There is no Cartesian cross-product and no hidden caller-side arbitrary selection.
unit_binding_dependency.requirement: open-key work must freeze CARD_CASE_WITH_EXPLICIT_UNIT_BINDING before any semantic pair answer or adjudication.
